title: Multi-agent coordination scaffold (SQLite + AGENT_COORD protocol)
author: Pukujan
body_excerpt:
## Goal

Add a lean local multi-agent coordination scaffold so concurrent agents can record who sent what, who owns which PR/issue/sub-issue, contradiction/collision flags, and idempotent checkpoint keys — without replacing GitHub as authority.

## Scope

**In**

- Local SQLite (or lean module) for: message/send log, ownership claims (issue/PR/sub-issue), contradiction/collision flags, idempotent…
